name: Reliable Time-Series Anomaly Detection Benchmark
description: A proposed benchmark and evaluation methodology aimed at creating a more reliable, standardized benchmark for time-series anomaly detection research.
reputation: Proposed as a more reliable, standardized evaluation for time-series anomaly detection; recognized in the research community but not yet a universally adopted standard.
notes: Benchmark covers heterogeneous time series and settings; results can be sensitive to label contamination, thresholding and evaluation protocol; not an LLM benchmark.
